assembly_notes: Shared identity core in every combination: one grounded `chassis` root, one molded `hopper` on a REVOLUTE `hopper_tilt` trunnion about world Y, a REVOLUTE `latch_pivot` retaining mechanism, two CONTINUOUS main-wheel rolls on one transverse axle and two swivel casters (CONTINUOUS swivel about Z + CONTINUOUS roll about Y). Five structural slots vary around it: hopper_form (molded section family), latch (retaining mechanism), push_handle, chassis (under-structure: three framed tiers plus the frameless molded_underbody) and caster (plain vs braked). deck_bearer_count is a structural multiplicity on chassis: the transverse steel bearers the tub floor seats on. hopper_length_m / hopper_width_m / hopper_depth_m / main_wheel_radius_m are the independent continuous parameters; every mating height, station and joint limit derives from them. Palette is non-core. Every rotational joint is solved with mate_axes and registered with register_interface_mate; the template emits no allow_overlap, and every pin/bore fit is a clevis or a sub-tolerance axial lap. model.meta['motion_interlocks'] declares the real operation order: the hopper only tilts once the latch is released, and (for foot_pedal_release) the pedal only travels with the latch released.

multiplicities.host_capacity_expression: 2 <= deck_bearer_count <= 4; below 2 the tub floor cantilevers off the trunnion, above 4 the bearers foul the main axle block and the latch clevis at the shortest hopper_length_m. On molded_underbody the bearers are the cradle ribs that pick the pan up inside the molded apron, so their half span is capped at apron_inner_y - 0.006 instead of the frame rail line; every N stays reachable at that narrower span.
multiplicities.name: deck_bearer_count
multiplicities.spacing_expression: bearer_x stations spread evenly over [x_floor_rear + 0.090, x_floor_front - 0.090]; the span derives from hopper_length_m and the active hopper_form floor descriptor. bearer_half_y = rail_y_out - 0.005 on the framed tiers and apron_inner_y - 0.006 on molded_underbody, so the cradle ribs stay inboard of the molded apron inner face.

candidates.name: molded_underbody
candidates.notes: Structural family: molded body forms the underbody. The chassis root keeps only compact hardware (two narrow longitudinal subframe channels on a track inboard of the tub floor line, one caster crossbeam, one axle cradle, the trunnion tower, the axle, the caster pads and the rear latch/handle mount); the full-length side rails and the cross-member ladder are gone. The hopper gains a closed molded underbody apron derived from the ACTIVE hopper_form plan builder (so a V-nose apron tapers, a barrel apron bows, an octagon apron keeps its facets), spanning z [skirt_z0, floor_z] and hiding the whole subframe band in side view. Identity core is unchanged: the trunnion REVOLUTE, the latch REVOLUTE, two fixed main wheels and two swivel casters all stay on this root link -- 'frameless' is a visual tier, not a topology change.
